item.title: Character Sculpt Dragonslayer
item.description:
This was my 2025 capstone project at Chatham University.

In this project my goal was to learn the workflows for creating a character covered in armor and implementing them into a game engine, in this case Unreal Engine 5.

I was able to be exposed to and learn about hard surface sculpting within ZBrush, rigging in Maya, rendering within Marmoset Toolbag 5, as well as Unreal Engine tools for animation retargetting.

item.title: Creature Sculpt Mimic
item.description:
Sculpting a mimic creature for a Halloween projection show that took place on the Library at Chatham University. This model was modeled in ZBrush as well as Maya, textured in Substance Painter, and rendered in Marmoset Toolbag 5. This piece was originally rendered in Unreal Engine 5 but was revised in Marmoset. The cloth backdrop was made in marvelous designer.

This model was made with the focused intention of rendering but is being worked on on the side to be rigged and animated.
